sentences.text: The fire salamander eats arthropods, lives on land, in water and underground, and is active by day, at dusk and dawn, and at night.
In Mainz-Bingen it has been reported 48 times over ten years, mostly from March to May and August to December, with October the peak month.
The barred grass snake is recorded as a predator, with 10 GloBI records.
The domestic cat is also recorded as a predator, with 2 GloBI records.
